findings.evidence: Change introduces unbounded retry on the non-MDL path: pkg/ddl/schemaver/syncer.go:289-293 now calls util.PutKVToEtcd(ctx, ..., putKeyRetryUnlimited, ..., clientv3.WithLease(s.loadSession().Lease())). Caller uses context.Background in Reload: pkg/infoschema/issyncer/syncer.go:365-408 (UpdateSelfVersion at :395) while holding s.m. PutKVToEtcd retries until ctx.Err or success: pkg/ddl/util/util.go:370-396; with context.Background it never stops. Second confirmation: Reload runs inline in the main SyncLoop goroutine (pkg/infoschema/issyncer/syncer.go:257-304), so a stuck Reload blocks handling <-syncer.Done() (and its schemaValidator.Stop()/restart safety path at :278-301). Upstream/master still has the same pattern (Reload calls UpdateSelfVersion(context.Background()), and UpdateSelfVersion uses putKeyRetryUnlimited when MDL is off), so not fixed later.
findings.fix: Make UpdateSelfVersion retry bounded/cancelable and session-aware: (1) pass a cancelable ctx from SyncLoop into Reload/UpdateSelfVersion (or wrap the call with a timeout derived from lease, e.g. 2*schemaLease) instead of context.Background; (2) in etcdSyncer.UpdateSelfVersion, avoid retrying forever with a potentially-stale lease ID—break/return when s.loadSession().Done() is closed and/or re-fetch the current session lease between retries (outer retry loop that recreates OpOption each attempt).
findings.impact: In MDL-disabled (classic) mode, persistent etcd/lease failures can block infoschema Reload indefinitely, freezing the schema sync loop. This can prevent processing syncer.Done (no restart) and bypass the intended schemaValidator.Stop safety gate on session loss, risking prolonged stale-schema operation (DDL propagation stalls; DML/query correctness/availability can degrade) and potentially hanging shutdown/restart flows.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked upstream/master (bab4993b6f...): Reload still calls UpdateSelfVersion(context.Background(), 0, ...) and non-MDL UpdateSelfVersion still uses putKeyRetryUnlimited + WithLease, so the hang/coordination risk remains.
findings.verify: Repro-style verification: in a classic/MDL-disabled run, simulate etcd outage > SessionTTL (or force session close) while a schema reload is happening and confirm SyncLoop can still hit <-syncer.Done() and restart; add a test that combines PutKVToEtcdError (forces retry) with ErrorMockSessionDone (closes session) and asserts Reload/SyncLoop doesn’t hang. Run existing realtikvtest coverage: go test ./tests/realtikvtest/ddltest -run TestUpdateSelfVersionFail.
findings.what: High risk of permanent hang / restart-safety bypass when MDL is disabled: UpdateSelfVersion now retries etcd Put “unlimited” using a non-cancelable context (via callers passing context.Background) and a lease captured once. If the etcd session/lease becomes invalid (e.g., prolonged etcd outage > TTL or domain close), the Put can never succeed and Reload can block indefinitely, preventing SyncLoop from handling syncer.Done() to stop validator and restart the syncer.

subject: ddl: add retry for updateSelfVersion (#62190)
summary: Switches non-MDL UpdateSelfVersion etcd write from single-attempt to putKeyRetryUnlimited; adds a PutKVToEtcd failpoint hook and a realtikvtest to simulate transient self-version update failures.
